**Generated** by `tools/flag_lines.py` from the producer files in `data/labeled/flags/` (newest check 2026-11-13); do not edit by hand. The same rows, machine-readable: `data/labeled/flags/flagged_lines.csv`. What a flag is, the columns, the severity rules and **what every agent must do** about a flag: `data/labeled/flags/README.md`.

In short: a prediction or ETA agent scores every flagged line (and its flagged stops, hours and buses) as its own slice and does not ship a model that loses on one (RouteKnower.md 6.4); an app agent reads the flags before changing a display rule and never hides a bus or a time on a flag alone without the owner's decision; a data agent rechecks the flags at every checkup.

Unofficial analysis of the public Passio feed; not a statement by the operator or the University. Official service information: 773.702.8181.
